messages.subject: Meridian - Contract for Sale, our mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up of the Contract attached (redline against your v1). The principal changes reflect what's been agreed: price down to £14,250,000, the roof retention up to £75,000, and we've tightened the warranty claim longstop to 12 months. Otherwise minor drafting.

Grateful for your turn. Amelia
